item.title: U.S. strikes Iran to prevent Hormuz mine threat
item.description: The U.S. military targeted Iranian sites to stop potential sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz, a U.S. official confirmed.

item.title: El-Sayed seeks Jewish Democrats' support but keeps Piker
item.description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed worked to rebuild ties with Jewish Democrats over the weekend, yet he remains committed to his association with progressive commentator Piker.

item.title: Tech giants turn to health care to counter AI criticism
item.description: To address public concerns about AI, leading companies are increasingly focusing on health care applications, aiming to demonstrate positive societal impact.

item.title: Google Maps adopts 'Lake America' as Canada likens change to 'SNL' skit
item.description: President Trump's directive to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' has sparked further debate, with tech companies deciding whether to follow the order and Canada comparing it to a comedy sketch.
